2	title: Getting Started
3	weight: 1
4	---
5	
6	## Install
7	
8	```bash
9	go install github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/cmd/fiz@latest
10	```
11	
12	## Quick Start with LM Studio
13	
14	1. Start [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/) and load a model with tool-calling support (e.g., Qwen 3.5).
15	
16	2. Run `ddx-agent`:
17	
18	```bash
19	ddx-agent -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
20	```
21	
22	DDX Agent connects to LM Studio at `localhost:1234` by default.
23	
24	## Quick Start with Anthropic
25	
26	```bash
27	export FIZEAU_PROVIDER=anthropic
28	export FIZEAU_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
29	export FIZEAU_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-20250514
30	
31	ddx-agent -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
32	```
33	
34	## Configuration
35	
36	Create `.agent/config.yaml` in your project:
37	
38	```yaml
39	provider: openai-compat
40	base_url: http://localhost:1234/v1
41	model: qwen3.5-7b
42	max_iterations: 20
43	session_log_dir: .agent/sessions
44	```
45	
46	Environment variables override the config file:
47	- `FIZEAU_PROVIDER` — `openai-compat` or `anthropic`
48	- `FIZEAU_BASE_URL` — provider base URL
49	- `FIZEAU_API_KEY` — API key
50	- `FIZEAU_MODEL` — model name
51	
52	## As a Library
53	
54	```go
55	import (
56	    "context"
57	    "github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau"
58	    _ "github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/configinit"
59	)
60	
61	func main() {
62	    a, err := agent.New(agent.ServiceOptions{})
63	    if err != nil {
64	        panic(err)
65	    }
66	    events, err := a.Execute(context.Background(), agent.ServiceExecuteRequest{
67	        Prompt:   "Read main.go and tell me the package name",
68	        ModelRef: "cheap",
69	        WorkDir:  ".",
70	    })
71	    if err != nil {
72	        panic(err)
73	    }
74	    for event := range events {
75	        _ = event
76	    }
77	}
78	```
79	
80	## Session Replay
81	
82	Every run is logged. Replay past sessions:
83	
84	```bash
85	ddx-agent log                  # list sessions
86	ddx-agent replay <session-id>  # human-readable replay
87	```

# DDX Agent

Embeddable Go agent runtime — local-model-first via LM Studio.

[![CI](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/releases/latest/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/releases/latest)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

DDX Agent is a Go library that implements a coding agent runtime — a tool-calling
LLM loop with file read/write, shell execution, navigation helpers, and
structured I/O. Designed to be embedded in
[DDx](https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/ddx) and other build orchestrators.
Prioritizes local model inference via LM Studio and Ollama, with transparent
escalation to cloud providers.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DocumentDrivenDX/agent/master/install.sh | bash
```

Or with Go:

```bash
go install github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/fizeau/cmd/fiz@latest
```

## Quick Start

Start [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/) with a model that supports tool
calling (Qwen 3.5+, Llama 3.2+), then:

```bash
ddx-agent -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
```

DDX Agent connects to `localhost:1234` by default.

### With Anthropic

```bash
export FIZEAU_PROVIDER=anthropic
export FIZEAU_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
export FIZEAU_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-20250514
ddx-agent -p "Read main.go and tell me the package name"
```

7	## Context
8	
9	Prior renames (from git history): `luce → lucebox`. Current working name: `agent`.
10	
11	One of the project's stated goals is supporting **testing**, **optimization**, and **one-shot results** — which is also why it has no TUI. The naming exploration was scoped to metaphors that fit that one-shot framing: scientists known for a single decisive experiment, famous sharpshooters, and golfers known for hole-in-one / albatross shots.

13	## Proposed names

18	## Why Fizeau
19	
20	Hippolyte Fizeau (1849) measured the speed of light using a single rotating toothed wheel and a mirror 8 km away — one precise measurement, one clean answer. The metaphor maps unusually well:
21	
22	- **One shot**: one rotation of the cog → one measurement
23	- **Precision over throughput**: not Monte Carlo, not statistical sampling — a single carefully-instrumented observation
24	- **No interactivity**: the cog spins, the light returns or it doesn't. No TUI in the apparatus.
25	- **Bonus**: the Fizeau–Foucault apparatus is literally a measurement *harness*
26	
27	Predates and is more on-brand than Foucault, who is overloaded philosophically.

85	
86	The rename is **broad** — every public-facing surface and internal reference is updated:
87	
88	- **Go module path** — `go.mod` module declaration, all `import` paths
89	- **Root package** — package name in `main.go` and any top-level package declarations
90	- **CLI binary** — output binary name, `cmd/` directory structure, `main` package
91	- **Config directories** — `~/.config/fizeau`, `~/.local/share/fizeau`, any XDG paths
92	- **Environment variables** — `FIZEAU_*` prefix (e.g. `FIZEAU_HOME`, `FIZEAU_LOG_LEVEL`)
93	- **Public docs** — README, godoc comments, any markdown under `docs/`
94	- **DDx dependency** — any reference to the project name in `.ddx/` configuration or execution artifacts
95	- **Release / updater** — release asset names, self-update endpoints, version tags

97	## Non-Goals
98	
99	- **Historical evidence rewrites** — git history, old commit messages, and archived research docs are **not** rewritten. The rename is forward-looking only.
100	- **Backward-compat aliases** — no `agent` or `lucebox` shim commands, no legacy config migration.
101	- **Domain registration** — acquiring `fizeau.dev` or `fizeau.io` is out of scope for this rename pass.
102	- **Package registry squatting** — publishing placeholder packages on PyPI/npm to block `fiz` is deferred.

105	
106	- **No compatibility window.** The rename is a hard break. Old config paths (`~/.config/agent`, `~/.config/lucebox`) and old env var prefixes (`AGENT_*`, `LUCEBOX_*`) are **not** read or migrated.
107	- Users must re-create config at `~/.config/fizeau` and set `FIZEAU_*` env vars.
108	- If a user has old config present, `fiz` prints a one-line hint pointing to the new path and exits with a non-zero code.

110	## DDx Dependency
111	
112	- The `.ddx/` directory and its configuration (bead queue, execution metadata, project config) reference the project name. All such references are updated to `fizeau`/`fiz`.
113	- DDx execution artifacts (`.ddx/executions/`) are **not** rewritten — they are historical evidence. New executions after the rename will use the new names.
114	- The `ddx init` command must **not** be re-run; the workspace is already initialized.

117	
118	Use a committed, deterministic script for the module/import-path rewrite. Do
119	not use `gopls`/`gorename` for the module path because the change is a literal

135	- Go import paths and active non-historical references that name the old module
